integrity: The all-parameter proof is combinatorial. A standalone exhaustive subset-DP verifier independently checks 33 small heterogeneous profiles, including boundary blade size two and selected profiles with blade size four. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least two clique blades and every blade has size at least two. It classifies only maximum Grundy total dominating sequences and their underlying sets, not shorter sequences. The scalar value of the Grundy total domination number is treated as prior-implied rather than new.
title: Maximum Grundy total dominating sequences of heterogeneous windmills
